nightly-eval-bot: nightly eval alert: 3 failing suites for model=redwood-v2-quant8 on cohort=production_promptset_A :rotating_light:
nightly-eval-bot: failures: coherence_diag (12/200), longcontext_trunc (34/200), blank_generation (47/200)
nightly-eval-bot: severity=high for blank_generation, medium for longcontext_trunc, low for coherence_diag
maria: :eyes: blank_generation spike looks bad. is this the new quant8 rollout?
sam: yes — we rolled redwood-v2 int8->quant8 image yesterday morning to canary pool 3. Not full traffic.
jordan: can anyone confirm whether KV cache changes were deployed with the quant build? I remember a cache key normalization change in the runtime PR.
kevin: that runtime PR landed in prod yesterday (runtimes/kv-cleanup). There's a change where history trimming now normalizes spaces before hashing.
alex: hmm that could cause mismatches for cached prefixes, maybe causing repeated empty generations when prefix lookup fails and fallback path triggers a different decode.
maria: attaching sample eval snippet from the runner:
```
[eval] prompt_id=8423 cohort=production_promptset_A model=redwood-v2-quant8 step=0
input="Summarize the following..."
output=""
log_prob=-inf
status=blank_generation
```

sam: initial plan: 1) pause canary for quant8 pool 3, 2) re-run failing prompts on previous redwood-v2-int8, 3) check cache hit rates and prefix hash diffs. Agree?
jordan: +1. I'll check cache hit metrics and diff the prefix hashes between builds.
kevin: I'll open a quick rollback on the canary if we confirm cache correlation.
maria: I can re-run the nightly eval subset locally against the int8 binary and quant8 but with legacy KV hashing enabled to confirm.
alex: FYI adding this to the incident runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/nightly-eval#kv-cache-mismatch :clipboard:
nightly-eval-bot: assigned owners: maria, jordan, kevin; ticket=EV-2026; runbook_link=https://redwood.internal/runbooks/nightly-eval#EV-2026
maria: I'm starting the re-runs now, will post results in ~20m.
sam: tagging @eng-runtime FYI — possible regression from runtime change.
jordan: found a 23% drop in prefix cache hits on the quant8 canary group vs int8 baseline for this cohort. dumping samples now.
kevin: if the drop reproduces across other cohorts we should cut traffic and roll back.
maria: re-run results: blank_generation reduced to 2/200 on int8 baseline, still 45/200 on quant8. longcontext_trunc also improved on int8.
alex: conclusion: likely KV hash normalization change + quant build differences exposed a cache eviction/collision pattern. Next steps: rollback canary, patch runtime to preserve previous hashing for now, add integration test that compares cache hit parity between builds.
sam: agreed. set severity=high, owners=maria/jordan/kevin, ETA initial rollback 30m.
maria: updating ticket EV-2026 with logs and samples.
kevin: rolling back quant8 canary now. will update when done.
nightly-eval-bot: update: canary rollback completed for pool 3 at ts=2765440320
maria: continuing postmortem draft after we confirm patch. thanks everyone. :heart:
